label: Ship steps

body.kind: Each kind runs a fixed set of stages in order and stops at the first failure.
body.build: The commit on main this run builds from. Releases and hotfixes also write the version tag.
body.rollback: The cluster pins that release’s images and rolls every service whose pin changes. No build.
body.prs: Ticked pull requests merge before anything builds. Only PRs with passing or running checks can be ticked.
body.changelog: Goes out with the release notes. English is required. French falls back to English when left empty.
body.review: Check what this run does, then start it. Nothing rolls back on its own.

releasesEmpty: No earlier release to roll back to.
